result.title: Understanding Data Augmentation under Label Noise
result.summary: Data augmentation (DA) has become a fundamental component of modern machine learning systems and is widely regarded as an effective strategy for improving robustness and generalization. Despite its empirical success, the theoretical impact of DA under label noise remains poorly understood. In this work, we first theoretically explain when DA is beneficial and when it becomes detrimental, and provide sufficient conditions for distinguishing between these two regimes under both the i.i.d. learning setting and the more challenging domain generalization scenario. Then, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: DA essentially acts as an uncertainty amplifier in the learning process, decreasing model stability and generalization performance. This finding is supported by the proposed learning and generalization bounds. Our analyses do not depend on specific DA techniques and require only mild assumptions, indicating that the results are applicable to a broad range of machine learning scenarios. Namely, we provide a unified theoretical foundation for understanding, analyzing, and designing DA methods in the presence of label noise.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从理论上分析标签噪声下数据增广何时有益、何时有害，给出区分两种情形的充分条件，并提出学习与泛化界，指出 DA 在学习中起到「不确定性放大器」的作用、会降低模型稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「增广在含噪监督下可能反而有害」的判据与稳定性视角，或可供核查 LVR 轨迹监督、含噪中间标注与增广训练设计的收益边界；但属纯理论、未涉及多模态，迁移到视觉推理需自行验证。
